name: 102 (Heliopolis Rock)
headline: The Terminal 1 Stay - Steps From Nightlife and Airport
summary: Hi and welcome to The Terminal! This new modern fully furnished apartment is close to Airport (5 min away), restaurants and dining options are at w...

description.Space:
This fully furnished apartment includes a spacious living room with a couch, a dining  table and a fully equipped kitchen. 

Cable TV and fast Wifi.

There are 2 bedrooms one of which is ensuite (with bathroom) and an additional separate bedroom.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment.
description.Interaction: Guests can text and call me anytime they need assistance. I’ll be happy to address any issues right away.
description.Neighborhood:
The neighborhood is packed with cafés and restaurants along Ankara street which is close to the apartment. 
This neighborhood is full of life with plenty of street food options (the apartment is quite and peaceful though) 

- Banks and other services are also within walking distance. 

- There is a sports complex for most sports activities (running track, football, basketball, squash, tennis..) which is a 10 min walk from the apartment. 

- Sun City Mall and Cairo Complex are within 5 min walking distance. 
- Giza Pyramids is a 50 min drive
- Downtown Cairo is a 30 min drive 
- New Cairo is a 15 min drive
- Cairo International Airport is a 5 min drive.
description.Transit: All places are reachable by car, Uber app and Careem app but if you want take a walk it's not going to take you more than 5 minutes to reach any of the services around.
description.Notes: Please note that additional unreported guests are not allowed to access or enter the property.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

 Xuru Stays

Superhost exceptionnel que je recommande fortement ! Très conciliant et à l'écoute. L'une des rares personnes qu'on a pu rencontrer en Egypte détenant ces qualités. Quant à l'appartement, il fait l'objet d'une propreté irréprochable et à quelques pas des restaurants, lounge, mall et supermarchés. Une chose est sure, faites votre réservation les yeux fermés.

John’s place was fantastic! The entire apartment was VERY clean and the beds were super comfortable! It had everything you needed (tea kettle, Nespresso machine, clean towels, heat, air conditioning, Wi-Fi); no need to bring anything other than your clothes! The check-in/out process was smooth and easy. John was very helpful and easy to talk to. This is my second time staying in one of his rentals and I will definitely be staying at his places again! 

Thank you John and the whole Xuru crew.

The apartment was a lovely place to rest after we landed at the Cairo airport. It was just 7 minutes by cab from there.
The place was clean, comfortable, and wonderfully warm against Cairo's cold winter. The hosts helped us check in, were responsive, and made sure we had a comfortable stay.
It was great besides the power shutting off, and the WiFi being terrible, other than that I’d definitely recommend!

John has a very nice house that can easily fit 6-7 people. Its proximity to the airport (5 mins) makes it a prime location for travelers. The house was super clean when I arrived and everything looked exactly like it was in the pictures. The Wifi was fast (compared to the average Wifi speed in Egypt). Even the security guard and janitor were super nice. 

My only complain, however, is that there are very small things that the house is missing which were quite irritating. For example, the bathroom did not have any tables, hangers, or towel racks to put my cloths/towel on while showering. The bath did not have any curtains, which caused lots of water to spray outside making the floor very slippery and dirty. The rooms also did not have any hangers with the exception of a few in the closet.

I would have also much appreciate it if some more toiletries were added, like shampoo, bodywash, and conditioner.

If the above issues were fixed, I'd definitely give this house a perfect rating.
